versions.subject: detect overwriting and deletion of files via dd
versions.detection:
selection:
   Image: '/bin/dd'
   CommandLine|contains: 'of='
   CommandLine|contains:
   - 'if=/dev/zero'
   - 'if=/dev/null'
condition: selection
